notes: Manulife has no ip_rider products in public/data/insurers.json (no Shield riders), so that category is empty.
Manulife pages return 403 to scripts; every cell cites the plan's brochure PDF.

Brochures are dated 2020 (term plans, Critical SelectCare) and 14 Sep 2025 (Early CompleteCare); entry ages, premium guarantees and waiting periods are mostly not stated in them, so those cells are left out.
ManuProtect Term (II): the brochure does not say whether premiums are guaranteed (it says only that renewal premiums follow the age at renewal), so premium is omitted.
ManuProtect Decreasing: the brochure gives no entry age for the standard version, only the Lite version (50 and below).

Critical SelectCare: the brochure does not state the critical illness claim count; the example shows the policy ending on a critical illness payout. Cover term (age 85) appears only in the worked example, so term is omitted.

Early CompleteCare: Classic vs Deluxe differ (Deluxe adds Cover Me Again, recurring/relapse and cancer income benefits); claims cell is for Deluxe only. The '1 year / 2 years waiting period' in the example is the claim-free gap between claims, not a waiting period after cover starts, so waiting is omitted.
Quotes keep the PDF's own ligature characters (e.g. the fi ligature in 'fixed') because the verifier matches the PDF text as extracted.
